prTitle: fix: add the comfirmation tracking of pcp

analysis.summary: Potential runtime error due to accessing properties on an undefined object in tracking logic.

bugs.title: Runtime crash due to missing 'products' data
bugs.description: The `products` object is destructured from `appContextData.data.analyticsData`. If `appContextData.data.analyticsData` does not contain a `products` property, `products` will be `undefined`. Subsequently, `products.extendedConnectedService!` will attempt to access a property on `undefined`, leading to a runtime TypeError.
bugs.risk: This is a HIGH severity bug because it will cause the 'Order Success' page to crash for users if the `products` data is missing in the `appContextData`. This prevents the user from seeing their order confirmation and will also cause the critical 'comfirmation' tracking event to fail, impacting analytics and user experience.

notBugs.reason: Adding new type imports and the `useTracking` hook are standard practices for extending functionality and do not introduce bugs themselves.

While `!` can mask potential `null`/`undefined` issues, the primary confirmed bug is the access on a potentially `undefined` `products` object itself, not specifically the `extendedConnectedService` being null (which would become `[null]` in the array). The `!` is a symptom, the lack of defensive coding for `products` is the root cause of the confirmed runtime error.
